edges.reason: _governance parameter assigned to the governance state variable in initialize.
_ibbtc parameter assigned to the ibbtc state variable in initialize.
_core parameter assigned to the core state variable in initialize.
initialize writes governance during contract initialization.
initialize sets the ICore reference.
_pendingGovernance parameter stored into pendingGovernance.
_core parameter stored into the core state variable.
onlyGovernance modifier gates setPendingGovernance on msg.sender == governance.
onlyGovernance modifier gates setCore on msg.sender == governance.
onlyPendingGovernance modifier gates acceptPendingGovernance.
msg.sender is compared against governance in the onlyGovernance check.
msg.sender is compared against pendingGovernance in the onlyPendingGovernance check.
msg.sender flows into mint as the depositor and recipient of minted shares.
msg.sender flows into burn as the burner and recipient of ibBTC.
msg.sender is used as the spender in the transferFrom allowance update.
msg.sender is the implicit sender in transfer.
_shares parameter passed into the external ibbtc.transferFrom call.
_shares parameter used as the mint amount in _mint.
_shares parameter used as the burn amount in _burn.
_shares parameter passed into the external ibbtc.transfer call.
sender parameter forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
recipient parameter forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
amountInShares local passed as the amount to _transfer.
amountInShares local used in the _approve allowance update.
amountInShares local passed as the amount to _transfer in transfer.
amount parameter converted through balanceToShares inside transferFrom.
amount parameter converted through balanceToShares inside transfer.
recipient parameter forwarded to _transfer in transfer.
balance parameter fed into the mul/div arithmetic of balanceToShares.
amountInShares derived from amount is subtracted from the allowance, risking underflow.
sender indexes the allowance mapping that is subtracted from.
amountInShares local is the subtrahend in the allowance subtraction.
ibbtc token contract is the external callee invoked by transferFrom.
ibbtc token contract is the external callee invoked by transfer.
core contract is the callee of pricePerShare().
mint invokes the external ibbtc.transferFrom before updating its own state.
mint calls _mint to credit wrapped shares.
burn calls _burn to debit wrapped shares.
burn invokes the external ibbtc.transfer after the burn state change.
transferFrom calls balanceToShares to convert amount into shares.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move shares.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction.
transfer calls balanceToShares to convert amount into shares.
transfer calls _transfer to move shares.
pricePerShare calls the external core.pricePerShare().
balanceOf reads pricePerShare from the external core.
balanceOf performs shares * pricePerShare / 1e18 arithmetic.
balanceToShares reads pricePerShare to derive the conversion rate.
balanceToShares performs balance * 1e18 / pricePerShare arithmetic.
sharesToBalance reads pricePerShare to derive the conversion rate.
Malicious ibbtc could reenter mint through transferFrom before _mint credits shares.
Malicious ibbtc could reenter burn through transfer.
core.pricePerShare() is invoked inside transferFrom before _transfer/_approve, allowing reentrancy via a malicious core.
core.pricePerShare() is invoked inside transfer before _transfer, allowing reentrancy via a malicious core.
account parameter indexes _balances inside balanceOf.
shares parameter converted through sharesToBalance.

normalization_plan.reason: _governance is a temporary argument of initialize and is absorbed into its assignment to governance.
_ibbtc is a temporary argument of initialize and is absorbed into its assignment to ibbtc.
_core is a temporary argument of initialize and is absorbed into its assignment to core.
_pendingGovernance is only used to write the pendingGovernance state variable.
_core is only used to overwrite the core state variable in setCore.
_shares is the transient deposit amount consumed by mint.
_shares is the transient redeem amount consumed by burn.
sender is a transient addressing argument of transferFrom.
recipient is a transient addressing argument of transferFrom.
amount is a transient value argument of transferFrom.
recipient is a transient addressing argument of transfer.
amount is a transient value argument of transfer.
balance is the sole transient input of the conversion helper balanceToShares.
shares is the sole transient input of the conversion helper sharesToBalance.
account is a transient lookup key used only inside balanceOf.
amountInShares is a local computed inside transferFrom and consumed before it returns.
amountInShares is a local computed inside transfer and consumed before it returns.
